name: How long does a typical marble tile installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical marble tile installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical residential bathroom or kitchen floor tile installation usually takes between three and five days from initial prep to final cleanup. Day one focuses on subfloor prep, leveling, and membrane installation. Day two involves layout dry-fitting, precision diamond-blade cutting, and setting the tiles in mortar. The mortar then requires a full 24-hour cure before grouting on day three or four. Finally, the surface is cleaned, grout is left to set, and penetrating sealers are applied once the materials dry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most residential installations take 3 to 5 days, accounting for subfloor prep, precise tile setting, overnight mortar curing, grouting, and final sealing.
